blocks.text: On arrival, you will be met at the airport and driven to your hotel. After check-in, the rest of the day is free. It is best to leave your first evening without a fixed plan. You can walk to the ocean, sit in a café near the hotel or simply stroll through the streets. Rio quickly draws you into everyday city life: conversations continue at the kiosks, music drifts from open doorways, and by evening the beach becomes a place to meet and walk. This is especially noticeable before Carnival. The city gradually fills with music, people and anticipation of the main event. The first day gives you time to settle into Rio after your flight and begin your journey at an unhurried pace.
